neighbours.label: the token ' hours' / ' hour' (also '-hour'), in any context
fire: Please call our support line during normal business hours if you have any questions about your order.
After three hours of tense negotiations, the two sides finally agreed on a draft treaty.
The pharmacy on the corner is open 24 hours, which is handy when the kids get sick at night.
We waited nearly two hours at the airport before the airline announced the delay.
Each private lesson lasts one hour and covers drawing, painting, and basic color theory.

The marathon runner finished the course in just under three hours, a personal best.
quiet: Customers with questions about an order can reach our support line during the working week.
